prompts.name: vaani
prompts.prompt: Create a polished 16:9 landscape anime illustration for a Bleach TYBW inspired personal software portfolio project cover. Cel shaded 2D anime background painting, precise ink contours, restrained luminous spiritual energy, deep petrol blue and moonlit cyan balanced with warm ivory, elegant cinematic negative space. Calm and beautiful rather than explosive. No text, no lettering, no logos, no UI, no border, no collage, no photorealism. One coherent landscape composition with a clearly readable central metaphor at thumbnail size. Voice AI: an elegant black Hell Butterfly above an antique ivory communication receiver on a stone ledge; soft concentric cyan sound ripples drift toward a distant pale Seireitei skyline under blue twilight.
